from PIL import Image
import os

def compress_image(input_image_path, output_image_path, max_size_kb=500, quality=85):
    # Open the image
    img = Image.open(input_image_path)
    
    # Convert to RGB if image is in RGBA
    if img.mode in ('RGBA', 'P'):
        img = img.convert('RGB')
    
    # Initial save with given quality
    img.save(output_image_path, 'JPEG', quality=quality, optimize=True)

    while os.path.getsize(output_image_path) > max_size_kb * 1024 and quality > 5:

        img.save(output_image_path, 'JPEG', quality=quality, optimize=True)
